questions.q: According to this lesson, what does the Alderbrook Wealth Partners case study prove about this course's eight chapters?
options: They function as one working incident response system, each chapter load-bearing for the ones that follow it
Only Chapter 7's threat hunting actually mattered in the case
Each chapter works entirely independently of the others
Chapter 1's lifecycle model was unnecessary once Chapter 8 began
questions.explain: Lessons 29 through 31 showed preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery, post-incident activity, and hunting all working together.

questions.q: Which chapter's judgment call decided that WKSTN-FIN-14 needed to be rebuilt from a verified-clean backup rather than cleaned live?
options: Chapter 5 — Eradication & Recovery
Chapter 2 — Preparation: Building an IR Plan
Chapter 1 — The Incident Response Lifecycle
Chapter 4 — Containment Strategies
questions.explain: Chapter 5's guidance on root cause and trust in a compromised host is what drove the rebuild-from-backup decision in Lesson 30.
